# Contributing

Thanks for wanting to help with `@xano/sdk`.

## We don't accept pull requests

Development happens in a private repository. This one receives a single commit
per release, so pull requests are turned off here.

## Report bugs as issues

If something in the SDK or the `xanosdk` CLI behaves differently than you
expected, **[open a bug report](https://github.com/xano-sdk/sdk/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)**.
The fastest reports to fix include:

- the exact command you ran (or the code that triggered it),
- the output, pasted verbatim,
- the `@xano/sdk` version (`npx @xano/sdk --version`) and your Node version.

Redact tokens and instance URLs before posting. `XANOSDK_DEBUG=1` prints raw
server responses, which can include values you'd rather not share in a public
thread.

## Questions and ideas

For how-to questions, feature ideas and general discussion, use the
**[Xano community](https://community.xano.com)**.

## Security

Never report a vulnerability in a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
